title: 87% of Customers Read Reviews Before Visiting a Local Business

segments.text: 87% of customers read reviews before visiting a local business. If you have five reviews, most of them go somewhere else.
87% Read Reviews Before Visiting a Local Business
segments.narration: Eight out of ten consumers read reviews before deciding where to spend money. If your listing has five reviews or fewer, a large share of those potential customers are already choosing a competitor.

segments.text: 73% of All Online Reviews Are on Google
segments.narration: Google accounts for 73 percent of all online reviews across every platform. When someone searches for a plumber or a restaurant nearby, the star ratings they see are Google's. Reviews on Yelp or Facebook stay on those platforms — Google reviews show up everywhere.

segments.text: 35% More Revenue for Businesses That Respond
segments.narration: Businesses that respond to their reviews earn 35 percent more revenue on average than those that don't. Responding signals to Google and to future customers that the business is active and paying attention.

segments.title: Where Consumers Check When Evaluating a Local Business
segments.narration: Google leads by a wide margin — 87 percent of consumers check it when evaluating a local business. Facebook and Yelp trail at 48 and 46 percent. Nothing else comes close. If your Google listing is weak, you're losing customers before they ever contact you.
